instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark voidmerch aesthetic. Never use orange anywhere.
Use Acid Lime (#D4FF00) as the high-impact accent color for primary buttons, active tags, and focus highlights.
Ensure language is Portuguese (BR) and currency formatted as BRL (R$). Initial featured product is 'Camiseta Champion Horse'.
Keep typography sharp and technical: Space Grotesk/Syne for big uppercase titles, JetBrains Mono for tags, sizes, and price specs.
Implement the side menu, side cart drawer, guest checkout flow, success/failure screens, search modal, and hidden admin route at /admlucas.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive components (buttons, inputs, links, cart items, size options, etc.)
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never apply transition: all globally; target specific properties like opacity, border-color, and background-color.
Keep generous padding and spacing (p-6, p-8, gap-8) with clear contrast and non-transparent dark surfaces.
Ensure mobile drawer menus and cart sheets have proper z-index (z-50) and accessible contrast.
